name: Shenzhen Edadoc Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Edadoc Technology Co.,Ltd. provides printed circuit board (PCB) design and PCB assembly manufacturing services in China and internationally. The company offers simulation analysis services, including DDRx simulation, high speed serial interface, power integrity simulation, system in packaging design, universal standard fixture, customized fixtures, and laboratory services; and PCB fabrication. It also provides component selection services. Shenzhen Edadoc Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
